title: Cops Step In After Toddler Found With Suspicious Injuries
description:
On September 8th, 2024. A worried mom called police when she noticed her 2-year-old son had marks and bruises after spending the week their dad. The mom stated that this has been ongoing for some weeks and that whenever he watches him, he returns with some injuries. Police confronted the man, and he claimed to not have noticed the marks and bruises but instead said his son was playing around and fell off a trampoline, even though the injuries and much more severe. This is the bodycam footage of the events.

Disclaimer: 

The videos on Police Watch are intended solely for informative and educational purposes. They are not meant to encourage or promote any illegal activities or unsafe behavior.  Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus. The content is designed to provide insight into law enforcement procedures, police interactions, and public safety awareness. Always respect the law and follow local regulations.
